chunks: Abu Jaʿfar and Abu ʿAbdillah, peace be upon them, said:
Whoever is killed through legal retribution (qisas), there is no blood money (diyyah) for him.

key_terms.الْقِصَاصُ: legal retribution in kind for a qualifying offense such as intentional killing
key_terms.دِيَةَ: blood money; financial compensation paid in designated cases of killing or injury
key_terms.مَنْ قَتَلَهُ الْقِصَاصُ: one upon whom lawful retaliatory execution has been carried out

ai.seo_question: Is blood money owed for someone killed through qiṣāṣ?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling in cases of qiṣāṣ: when a person is lawfully executed in retaliation, no diyah is due on his behalf. It clarifies that the implementation of judicial retribution does not generate an additional financial liability.
